failureDescription: A workbench may open or eventually render while using a renderer/fallback different from the required route, or may be visibly slow without browser-observed phase evidence identifying the bottleneck.

deduplication.PUBLIC_WEB_DELIVERY_GATE: Already proves public accessibility, browser startup, and interaction, but not the actual renderer route or phase timing.
deduplication.MOTHER-NO-METHOD-INVENTION-001: Already prohibits unauthorized method changes, but does not define browser-observed runtime evidence.
deduplication.TERRAIN-NO-STALE-DELIVERY-001: Already covers stale or wrong-target lineage, not current-page renderer identity or latency attribution.

mustNeverRepeat: source claims WebGL2 while the observed canvas uses WebGL1 or Canvas2D
a silent renderer fallback receives browserPassed=true
producer self-report overrides independent browser observation
a slow workbench is delivered without first-valid-frame and resource timing evidence
a universal latency threshold is invented when the Task Anchor has no device/browser budget
requiredEvidence: target URL and exact commit/content subject
required renderer route and allowed fallback policy from Task Anchor
independently observed canvas context type and constructor
gateLogic: missing budget produces UNKNOWN rather than PASS or FAIL
activationRequirement: Historical replay plus one affected Mother trial and independent verifier receipt.
